name: Marubozu entry with 3-bar color-flip exit
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
indicators: Candle body EMA average, shadow % filter
entry_long: Enter long on a white (bullish) marubozu: long body above body EMA average and small/no shadows relative to body (ShadowPercent).
exit: Long exit: current candle green after two previous red candles; short exit: current candle red after two previous green candles.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Shadow percent and body length inputs set pattern thresholds (C_ShadowPercent default in script).
